create_SentenceLevelEvaluator: create a SentenceLevelEvaluator instance from argparse arguments to evaluate a simulation system
run_evaluator_system: run the SentenceLevelEvaluator __call__ method with a system object to evaluate source-target sentence pairs
build_instances_from_dataloader: build evaluation instances from a dataloader for a given source and target type pair
summarize_evaluator_results: summarize evaluator results as a pandas DataFrame combining quality and latency scores
dump_evaluator_metrics: dump per-instance metrics and overall scores to TSV files in the output directory
